prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1140; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care for them. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage limits of every policy that may apply to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page for each. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling it.

Your insured's vehicle, any photographs, dash camera or telematics data, witness statements, recorded calls, and the claim file itself must be preserved in their current condition. Destruction, alteration, or disposal of any such material could seriously prejudice our client's claim. We expect written confirmation that a litigation hold has been placed on all relevant records. We look forward to your prompt response.
